name: FroDock 3.12 through published PINDER adapter
build_commands: apt-get --allow-releaseinfo-change update      && apt-get -y install --no-install-recommends      apt-utils      dialog 2>&1      && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends      git      rsync      ssh      gpg      wget      man-db      procps      tree      unzip      gcc      build-essential      lsb-release      curl      vim      exuberant-ctags      apt-transport-https      ca-certificates      gnupg      libgl1-mesa-glx       libopenblas-base      libopenmpi-dev openmpi-common openmpi-bin libopenmpi3      libfftw3-3 libfftw3-dev libfftw3-mpi-dev      libhdf5-openmpi-dev      && apt-get autoclean      && apt-get autoremove      && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

micromamba install -y -n base -c conda-forge      pyopenssl=23.2.0      python=${MAMBA_PYTHON_VERSION}      requests=2.25.1      google-cloud-storage      gcsfs      keyrings.google-artifactregistry-auth      && micromamba clean --all --yes

echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] http://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main" | tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list && curl https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | apt-key --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg  add - && apt-get update -y && apt-get install google-cloud-cli -y
python -m pip install      simple-gcp-object-downloader      kubernetes      pandas==1.5.3
git clone https://github.com/pinder-org/pinder.git;      cd pinder && pip install .
tar -xf frodock.tar.gz &&      mv frodock3_linux64 frodock &&      rm frodock.tar.gz
build_notes: Commands recorded verbatim from published build recipe, not executed. RUN list includes every install/build step. Mirror must be supplied as local frodock.tar.gz. Recipe defects and mutable clone require reviewed fixes before reproduction. Do not silently execute verbatim recipe as verified.
run_commands: pinder_methods predict -m <method> -s <test set> -l <list of PINDER ids> -c `config` -r `results_dir`
run_commands_note: Published command templates, not invented executable invocations. Concrete inference config/paths still need materialization; API names and argument support available in source.

published_configuration.dock_flags: --th 10 -t A; receptor vdw/electrostatic/desolvation maps, ligand desolvation map; bin/soap.bin
published_configuration.n_solutions_reason: Required by adapter but no published numeric run configuration established.
published_configuration.study_exact_pin_reason: Mirror bytes pinned; original study archive/scoring identity unverified.
